tasks.short: Secure an agreement or submit the contest.

steps.what: Show the assessment figures already computed.
Secure the taxpayer agreement or mark the case contested.
Review the determination before it is submitted.
Submit the contested determination to the appeals hearing.

tasks.design: Assessment figures already computed are shown from the {ERP}. The revenue agent secures the taxpayer’s agreement to discharge the assessment or marks the determination contested. A contested case is submitted to the appeals hearing only after the agent accepts that version. The figures do not secure the agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agreement was discussed from memory of the assessment, and the contest was sent without the current figures.
tasks.enabler_now: The computed figures can be on the table before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A taxpayer who will not agree, and a contest the figures do not support.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see correct figures that the taxpayer should not be pressed to accept.
tasks.altitude: The figures are in the room. The agent still secures the agreement or marks the contest. Nothing is submitted before that acceptance.

reach.task: Put the figures in front of the person and still hold the conversation.
reach.learn: The figures can be shown. The agreement stays here.

evidence.claim: Computed assessment figures can be shown before a conversation. They cannot secure an agreement or choose an appeals path.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Assessment id and figure id, produced by the assessment. An assessment with no figure id is not shown. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the assessment the office already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the revenue agent.
unknowns: Who the judicial or administrative conferees are.
Which contests must be submitted on paper.
research_questions: What share of assessments already have computed figures?
Which agreements are always taken by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still secures the agreement or marks the contest.
The agent still reviews the determination.

incremental.description: The agent corrects a figure the sheet showed from an old assessment.

approvals.approved_version: submission version and the assessment ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is showing figures already computed. It disappears when the figure id is missing and the agent rebuilds the sheet. Securing the agreement and reviewing the contest stay with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent still secures the taxpayer’s agreement or submits the contest to a hearing. The assessment figures can be on the table before that conversation, and nothing is submitted before the agent accepts the version.
reach: Claims adjusters put the figures in front of a person and still hold the conversation, and this job learns the agreement is still that conversation.
Regulatory affairs specialists submit a contested file only after a person accepts the version, and this job learns the same gate.
skills_to_grow: Show only assessment figures already computed.
Submit a contested determination only after the agent accepts that version.
role.ambitious_version: Computed assessment figures are ready before the conversation, and the agreement or the referral to a hearing is still the agent’s act.

job.title: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
